responsibility: Defines the main rs6000 target option table consumed by GCC’s option parser. It declares the persistent target variables for ISA flags, CPU selection, ABI and scheduling controls, builtins, code model, vector and floating-point policies, and then binds the large set of -m options for PowerPC features, processors, vector extensions, fusion modes, float128, stack-protector details, and debugging controls to those variables and masks.
same_name_distinction: This is the main rs6000 option table, declaring target variables and the broad set of -m switches for processors, ISA features, ABIs, vectors, and floating-point behavior. Unlike powerpcspe.c it does not implement backend behavior, unlike powerpcspe.h it does not provide target macros, and unlike powerpcspe.md it does not describe RTL instructions.
